note: Owner, 2026-09-30: "move to a cadence of updating the data every 4 hours or so ... never end up using more than 70% of my API quota." every_hours is the refresh cron's period (refresh.yml: cron `0 */4 * * *`, changed by hand together with this file; the watchdog's quiet threshold is every_hours + 1 h). quota_fraction is the share of the hourly Warcraft Logs limit EVERY collector process may spend, read by scripts/wcl_client.py whenever WCL_QUOTA_FRACTION is not set: the ceiling is measured against the account's live spend, so the sweep, the bundle, the trinket and keystone collectors and the owner's own lookups together never pass it. data/backfill.json, while its `until` is in the future, overrides quota_fraction with its `share` and chains runs back to back (scripts/backfill.py).
